title: Does High FPS make you a better gamer? Ft. Shroud - FINAL ANSWER
summary: Linus Tech Tips tests whether higher frame rates and refresh rates improve gaming performance, using Shroud and other players on aim and reaction tests at 60, 144 and 240Hz. The video is sponsored by Nvidia.
why: HN commenters cite it as informal evidence that higher refresh rates measurably help both pro and casual players, even though it is more entertainment than rigorous science.

quote.text: LTT also tested this for FPS games and both professionals and casual gamers improved significantly going from 60HZ to 144+.
